text:
The syntax error is fixed and `obt_product_inventory` now builds successfully.

The cause was a missing comma in the `source` CTE. `p.supplier_company` was followed directly by `p.standard_cost` with no comma, so the parser failed at the `.` before `standard_cost`. I added the comma in `models/analytics_obt/obt_product_inventory.sql`, and no other changes were made.

The rebuild of `obt_product_inventory+` finished with success=1. I did not check the output values, since the task was only about the syntax error.

My first report call was malformed and rejected, so the report was submitted on the second attempt.
